source: Exact pre-erasure PublicApiIR types. Runtime/Specialized/JsIR are used only to validate correspondence and bind actual exports, never to infer the source API.
supportedSourceTypes: Exact built-in scalar constants with no universe arguments
Nondependent runtime function binders, including higher-order function parameters
Array with zero universe arguments and a supported element type, matching psPreludeEnvArray0 / psPreludeArrayOf
genericProjection: The structural source-signature projection retains a prefix of syntactically non-Prop type binders, structured source names and de Bruijn references. Closed publication rejects generics. Explicit uniform publication requires a real retained generic function export, alpha-maps source parameter indices to observed RuntimeIR parameter names, and checks exact arity and function shape.
validation: Bounded canonical source/IR/table decoding and exact artifact kinds/bytes.
Complete observed erasure inventory and source-name/order correspondence.
RuntimeIR and VerifiedIR bytes identical; closed specialization reruns the independent correspondence relation, while uniform selection requires its exact tagged payload to preserve VerifiedIR bytes.
Complete selected IR/JsIR declaration and parameter inventories agree.
Each source-derived signature equals its observed RuntimeIR signature, including generic alpha-correspondence and flattened runtime calling convention.
Every JsIR declaration has exactly one source-owned export; actual names come from observation, not name-mangling guesses.

Bounded verification pins all seven profile-specific subjects and selected profile, then reconstructs all three products. Common graph/bundle/archive routing supports both closed and explicitly selected uniform profiles.

representation.precision: JavaScript runtime representation, without refinement types for Nat bounds, integer ranges, Unicode scalar constraints or float precision.
representation.valueDeclarations: Private collision-free declaration aliases with explicit ES export aliases retain exact emitted names.

independence: Requested declaration failure does not decide kernel acceptance or executable-only output. Origin and generated-position maps are not dependencies of declarations.
toolchain: Generation never calls tsc. The pinned repository TypeScript compiler is a focused independent consumer check only.
unsupported: Generic runtime exports under the current closed specializer
Dependent value types, proposition erasure inference, higher-rank generics
Named type aliases, structures/inductives and type-level computation
Declaration position maps and live portable-writer service routing
Runtime refinements, independently proved source projection or executable preservation
Generic constants that would require inventing a callable factory
assumptions: Selected JS printer exports the JsIR declaration inventory

portableSourceProjection.algorithm: Explicit task/value worklist and bounded prefix scan; curried structural fuel recursion; lexical scope markers preserve source generic indices and reject dependent runtime values.
portableSourceProjection.resourcePolicy: At most 128 prefix binders/scope entries/type depth; caller-selected positive work-step budget (default 400000) plus separately bounded prefix work. The host comparator counts source nodes, so resource units are intentionally not equated.
portableSourceProjection.output: Canonical psc-source-signature-structural/1 signature objects retain exact source binder names and visibility. No source normalization, target inference, live authority or semantic theorem.

portableDeclarationWriter.inputs: Body-free PublicApiIR plus increasing source-index/exact-export-name requests from independently checked erasure/export binding; closed or uniform JavaScript64 profile.
portableDeclarationWriter.algorithm: Single forward declaration scan and explicit type/output worklist; structural fuel recursion and balanced text builder. Generic indices, ASCII export names, source-index order/range and output budgets reject explicitly.
portableDeclarationWriter.resourcePolicy: Positive caller-selected writer steps and output bytes; default 1000000 steps and 64 MiB. Each selected source projection separately uses its 400000-step/128-depth limit. Identifier scanning is bounded by its output-sized byte length. Projection resource units are not writer steps.
portableDeclarationWriter.authority: Candidate bytes only: caller must validate complete source/runtime/export correspondence and uniqueness; no standalone inventory or type-preservation authority.
portableDeclarationWriter.validation: Actual compiled closed/generic/higher-order/Array declarations compare exact bytes with the independent host writer and use the existing pinned TypeScript consumer. Focused sparse alias, empty module, request order/range, malformed name, generic policy and exact budget checks are added; cloud run pending.
